rec.name: Post-Add-to-Cart Protection Plan Pop-up (Warranty Upsell)
rec.status: Reference only (duplicate ticket, no written spec)

what.text: A modal that opens on the PDP right after the shopper adds a product to the cart. The top bar confirms the add (small product thumbnail, check mark, 'Added to Cart') and offers a 'Checkout Now' button plus a close (X). The body offers a lifetime protection plan for a one-time fee ($199.99 in the reference). It has a headline with price, a short benefit list (tighten loose stones, resize rings and bands, expert clean and polish), a 'Learn more' link, an explainer video with a play button on the left, and a prominent black 'Add To Bag' button that adds the plan to the order. The PDP behind it shows the same offer as an expandable checkbox row under the size selector.

why.text: The shopper has just committed to the purchase, so the pop-up appears at peak intent, when the risk of a high-value purchase is most on their mind. A one-time payment for 'lifetime' protection lowers the fear of damage or loss and justifies the price. A concrete list of covered services and a human explainer video make the value tangible and build trust. Because the offer comes after the main add-to-cart, it works as a low-friction add-on that raises AOV and margin. The 'Checkout Now' button next to it keeps the path to purchase clear, so the upsell does not block the funnel.

how.text: Trigger the modal after a successful add-to-cart (AJAX) on the PDP, only for eligible products such as high-value or damage-prone items. Layout: a header row with thumbnail, 'Added to Cart' and a secondary 'Checkout Now' button; a body with video or image on the left and offer title, price, bullets and 'Learn more' on the right; a primary 'Add To Bag' button for the plan. Implement the plan as a separate hidden product or variant, priced fixed or by percentage, and add it to the cart with the main product on click. Mirror the offer on the PDP as an optional checkbox row, as shown in the screenshot. Keep the close button obvious so the shopper can decline without friction.

items: Enable/disable the pop-up and the PDP checkbox row
Eligible products or collections (tag or metafield, or a minimum price threshold)
Protection plan product or variant and price (fixed or % of the item price)
Primary CTA label ('Add To Bag') and secondary CTA ('Checkout Now')

dependencies.text: A protection plan set up as a Shopify product or variant that can be added to the cart as a line item (and linked to the main product if it needs to be removed with it). Ajax cart or cart-drawer hooks to catch the add-to-cart event. Optional product metafield for eligibility. Optional video hosting. No app was specified in the ticket.

items: Add-to-cart to checkout conversion rate (guard against upsell friction)
Pop-up close rate and 'Checkout Now' click rate
Video play rate and 'Learn more' click rate
Return/claim rate or margin impact of plan sales

images.caption: Reference: 'Added to Cart' modal with 'Checkout Now', a protection plan offer ($199.99) with a video, a benefit list and an 'Add To Bag' button, over a PDP that also has an expandable protection checkbox row.
Layout shown: header with thumbnail and confirmation, video on the left, offer copy and CTA on the right; the PDP behind it carries the same offer under the size selector.
